notes: The first article is displaced by αὐτοῦ (rule 20) and the second is a second attributive article with no English realization (rule 23).
ἀγρῷ is anarthrous, so the supplied the is an ordinary rule 7 helper on the noun (rule 51's anarthrous clause), while τῇ οἰκίᾳ's article takes to the under rules 17 and 21.
ἤγγισεν → drew nigh heads on nigh, as at 15:1.
